name: Graverobbers
summary: At the Mass Grave southwest of Garren's Haunt, Rot Hide gnolls dig up the dead. Magistrate Sevren sends you to stop them and recover their embalming ichor for the Royal Apothecary Society's research.

sections.title: Desecration of the Mass Graves
sections.body: The Plague of Undeath overwhelmed Tirisfal Glades, and the dead outnumbered those who could bury them. Immense mass graves were dug across the north to hold the countless victims. For a time, the buried escaped resurrection. Now the Scourge sends Rot Hide gnolls to the trenches southwest of Garren's Haunt. They exhume the decayed remains to swell the Lich King's armies.

sections.title: Turning Scourge Alchemy Inward
sections.body: Embalming ichor preserves and animates the Rot Hides' rotting frames. Magistrate Sevren sends you to slay the graverobbers and recover the fluid. This stops the Scourge from harvesting bodies and gives Brill's apothecaries valuable specimens. They hope to turn the Lich King's own alchemy against him.

faq.q: Why is the Scourge digging up the Mass Grave?
aliases: what does the scourge want with bodies
faq.answer: The Scourge digs up the Mass Grave's victims from the Plague's first arrival in Tirisfal to raise new soldiers and swell its armies against the Forsaken.

faq.q: What are the Rot Hide gnolls?
faq.answer: Rot Hide gnolls are undead gnolls enslaved by the Scourge. Embalming ichor animates and preserves them, and they serve as scavengers and shock troops around Garren's Haunt and the neighboring graves.

faq.q: Where is the Mass Grave located?
faq.answer: The Mass Grave lies southwest of Garren's Haunt, in the northern hills of Tirisfal Glades, just north of Brill.

faq.q: What do the Forsaken want with the Embalming Ichor?
faq.answer: Magistrate Sevren gives the collected ichor to Forsaken apothecaries. They study how the Scourge animates and maintains its lesser thralls, seeking weaknesses to exploit in the ongoing war.

faq.q: Who orders the death of the Graverobbers?
faq.answer: Magistrate Sevren, Brill's Forsaken overseer, orders the graverobbers killed to defend Tirisfal's borders and secure useful reagents for the Apothecaries.

faq.q: Why do the Forsaken care if dead plague victims are raised?
faq.answer: The Scourge turns every corpse it claims into an enemy soldier under the Lich King's will, threatening the newly liberated Forsaken kingdom.

angles.text: As Forsaken, you help keep the Scourge from raising Tirisfal's former citizens and condemning your fallen countrymen to mindless servitude.
As Horde, you help halt the Scourge's resupply efforts and secure northern Lordaeron, strengthening the Horde's foothold against the Lich King's remaining forces.
